checks.explanation: A wave of prominent business and finance figures publicly declared support for Trump through the rest of the 2024 campaign, including high-profile endorsements from tech leaders.
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 race on July 21, 2024, squarely within the predicted 30-60 day window from this late-May recording.

Trump clearly outperformed Biden in the June 27, 2024 debate, Biden's polling support cratered, and Democratic leaders orchestrated his withdrawal in favor of Kamala Harris, closely matching this prediction.
Democrats did switch nominees in July 2024, but Kamala Harris lost the November 2024 election to Trump rather than winning in a landslide.
Contrary to this prediction, the Democratic Party did successfully replace Biden with Kamala Harris in July 2024.
Dr. Fauci's early June 2024 congressional testimony was highly contentious and widely covered, generating significant controversy over COVID-19 origins.
As with the related prediction, Fauci's hearing proved highly eventful and newsworthy as predicted.
Bitcoin has grown substantially but has not replaced gold as a store of value; gold itself has also surged to record highs, and Bitcoin has not become a common medium for transacting in hard assets.
Crypto policy did become a more prominent political issue through the 2024 election, but the specific claim that it was worth about 5 percentage points of the vote is not independently verifiable.
Crypto holders did lean toward Trump as the perceived pro-crypto candidate, but the specific turnout and vote-share figures cited cannot be precisely confirmed.
Bored Ape Yacht Club NFT prices have remained far below their bubble-era highs and have not shown a meaningful recovery.
Salesforce stock and business recovered after the May 2024 selloff, with the company successfully pivoting toward AI products like Agentforce.
Trump's New York conviction resulted in an unconditional discharge sentence and the appeal process has continued without a final overturning ruling as of the most recent information.
Polling and commentary broadly supported the view that the conviction generated sympathy for Trump among independents rather than reducing his standing, consistent with his subsequent election win.
The conviction resulted in an unconditional discharge with no jail time or fine, effectively a minor consequence as predicted.
The Democrats' strategy of using Trump's felon status as a central attack line did not prevent him from winning the 2024 election.
Rather than contracting, AI and tech stocks entered a major boom through the rest of 2024 and into 2025, with valuations and investor enthusiasm expanding rather than compressing.
Despite continued massive AI infrastructure spending, Nvidia and major hyperscalers continued to perform very strongly through 2025 without the predicted market punishment materializing.
Rather than a sustained economic slowdown and multiple compression, the tech sector saw strong growth, high enterprise AI spending, and valuation expansion through the following period.
There is no available confirmation of whether the Poker Power bootcamp filled all 80 spots quickly.
There is no confirmed public record of whether and when the All-In Podcast reached 1 million subscribers or whether the associated Vegas party occurred.
